extDescription.message: Shows the travel direction of long-distance trains during seat booking on bahn.de

mixedInfo.message: bahn.de always lists coaches in ascending order, however the train sets are coupled. That is why they look opposed here.

mixedReal.message: How the train is coupled as scheduled (direction of travel →):

directionChanges.message: The travel direction changes during the journey as follows:

noValidityHint.message: No wagon order available for this date.

disclaimer.message: *Wagon orders may change on the day of travel.

donateAppeal.message: This is a hobby project – I’d appreciate a small donation!

obHeading.message: One click is all it takes

obSub.message: As soon as you select a seat on bahn.de, simply click the ICE icon at the top of your browser — and the direction of travel is shown immediately.

obPinTip.message: Tip: click the puzzle icon next to the address bar and pin Train Direction so the icon is always visible.

needDialog.message: The direction of travel can only be shown once you are in the booking process and have opened the “Select seat” dialog („Sitzplatz auswählen“).

notOnBahnDe.message: The direction of travel is shown on bahn.de during booking.

almostThere.message: Almost there: click “Sitzplatz auswählen” (choose seat) for your train, then click this icon again.

fernbahnAccessNeeded.message: To show the coach order, the extension still needs access to fernbahn.de.

fernbahnAccessPathMac.message: If nothing happens: Safari → Settings → Extensions → Fahrtrichtung → “Edit Websites…” → set fernbahn.de to “Allow”.

fernbahnAccessPathIos.message: If nothing happens: Settings → Apps → Safari → Extensions → Fahrtrichtung → set fernbahn.de to “Allow”.

errSourceDown.message: The coach sequences come from fernbahn.de – the site is currently overloaded or briefly unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.

errNoData.message: Unfortunately there is no coach sequence for this train.

errGeneric.message: The direction of travel could not be loaded just now. Please try again in a moment.

cachedNotice.message: fernbahn.de is currently unavailable – showing the coach sequence loaded last time (on $1).

mirrorNotice.message: fernbahn.de is currently unavailable – showing a cached coach sequence (as of $1).
